pages.text: A creature of ancient ages, long extinct, of which no trace is to be found anywhere today.$(br)Fortunately, once you had read the Bygone Scroll from cover to cover, you found the spoor of this vanished beast.$(br)And after some time spent researching, you found a way to turn the Sniffer - itself a creature of ages past - into a Scorchback.

Unlike its rather cute looks, the Scorchback has an exceedingly tough body; it can fire the quills on its back at its enemies, and it can also batter them with a long charge.$(br)You can right-click the Scorchback with Nether Wart to restore its health.$(br)Health 400 / Armor 16 / Toughness 8 / Knockback Resistance 1.0 / Speed 0.3125 / Attack 20 / Follow Range 35; no natural regeneration.
